name: Baked Apple Cinnamon Oats
ingredients: ½ cup plain unsweetened high-protein soy yogurt
1 tsp cinnamon and ¼ tsp nutmeg
½ tsp baking powder and ½ tsp vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease two ramekins.
Mix the oats, grated apple, soy milk, yogurt, flaxseed, spices, baking powder, vanilla and salt.
Bake for 28–30 minutes until set and golden on top.
Serve warm. The apple provides all the sweetness.
note: No added sugar; the grated apple and soy yogurt provide sweetness, protein and moisture.
